entries.en: to prepare (a corpse) for burial; to dress and arrange the body of the dead
entries.notes: 西语 amortajar 为 17 世纪丧葬术语（为死者入殓整衣）；汉字「殮」栏有〔疑〕记号，故降为 medium。

entries.en: to wrap up (a corpse); to swaddle

entries.zh: 浅腹；气浅，腹中不平（怒而不满）
entries.en: shallow-bellied; of shallow breath; vexed in the belly (ill-humoured)
entries.notes: 西语 Amotacado q. enojo（恼怒）；「淺腹」对音清晰但词义须由西语 q. enojo 反推，存疑标注。

entries.en: to wind together; to roll up
entries.notes: Amotinar q. rebolar（卷绕）；汉字栏有〔疑:樛/樓〕，故 medium。

entries.en: to throw into disorder; to tangle up
entries.notes: amotinar＋「亂」互证；汉字首字仍有〔疑:樛/樓〕记号。

entries.en: to rely upon; to expect help from
entries.notes: Amprar 为 amparar 缩略，q. aiudas＝「如 help」；汉字有〔疑:怙/忖〕，官话栏音 (chuei) cŭ 与闽南音有出入，medium。

entries.en: to look after; to take care of, protect
to watch over; to look after attentively
to depend on; to lean upon (for protection)
to explain; to interpret; to set straight
entries.notes: 西语栏「inuerçades」拼写残乱、缩写展开依赖推断，medium。

entries.zh: 作主；庇护人做其主（为…撑腰）
entries.en: to act as master over; to take charge of, stand as patron
entries.notes: 「seramo supatron」（será mo su patron）为残乱拼写，靠「作主」与 amparar 语境推断，medium。

entries.en: to receive shelter; to be under someone's protection
to cover over; to shade and shield

entries.zh: 遮拦；站到中间挡在前头（遮挡）
entries.en: to block; to stand in between as a screen
entries.notes: 「欄」有〔疑:欄/攔〕记号；西语栏 p̃ ſo den delant 为缩略残文，medium。
汉字、闽南、官话三栏皆 [空]，仅存西语词头 Janglian，无法定夺。
